items.statement: The submitted calculations preserve the four source-defined molecular identities and neutral singlet boundary, with no substitution of a paper label for a structure.
items.expected: Per-molecule identity, formula, charge and multiplicity are traceable in the submitted artifacts.

items.statement: Geometry and excited-state calculations are independently validated for convergence/completion, state labels, units and S1/T1 gap arithmetic.
items.expected: The report includes convergence/completion evidence and identifies how state ordering and ΔE(S1−T1) were checked for each molecule.

items.statement: The four computed S1/T1 gaps reproduce the source-reported pattern with the anthracene derivative having the largest gap among the four.
items.expected: Ph-mP, Na-mP, An-mP and Py-mP gaps are approximately 0.88, 0.89, 1.34 and 1.11 eV, respectively, within method/conformer uncertainty.

items.statement: Excited-state diagnostics show mixed local and charge-transfer character for the relevant low singlet and nearby triplet states rather than a purely local or purely charge-transfer assignment.
items.expected: NTO and/or fragment analysis reports both overlap/localization and donor-to-terminal-fragment separation, with molecule/state identity retained.
